data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to support Game Center and Google Play Games services.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin providing integration for Game Center on iOS and macOS, and Google Play Games services on Android. It allows managing achievements, leaderboards, saved games, and player authentication.
use_when: You are building a game in Flutter that needs native achievements or leaderboards.
You need cross-platform game service sign-in and cloud saves for mobile or desktop.
avoid_when: Your app is a standard business or utility app rather than a game.
You do not need native game center or play games features.
strengths: Provides access to game services like leaderboards, achievements, and saved games
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration on Google Play Console and App Store Connect.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuration in Google Play Console and App Store Connect, along with minimum SDK version constraints.
